title: Director, Information Technology Programs
bio: Bruce Huang is the director of the IT master's degree programs at Harvard Extension School. He is a scholar and practitioner in the field of computer science.
research_interests: My expertise lies at the intersection of technology
and leadership. With a background in computer science
focusing on diversity in applied learning
and pioneering strategic partnerships for curriculum advancement.
